title: Products with High Average Review Rating
description: Find all products with an **average rating of 4.0 or higher** AND **at least 3 reviews**. Show product name, category, avg_rating (rounded to 2 decimals), and review_count, ordered by avg_rating descending.
solution_sql: SELECT p.name, p.category, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating, COUNT(r.review_id) AS review_count FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name, p.category HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4.0 AND COUNT(r.review_id) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

test_cases.description: Yoga Mat(4.67,3), Bluetooth Speaker(4.33,3), Laptop Pro(4.25,4) qualify. Running Shoes(3.0 avg), Coffee Maker and Headphones (2 reviews each) are excluded.

hints: JOIN products with reviews on product_id, then GROUP BY product to compute AVG(rating) and COUNT(reviews) per product.
Use HAVING (not WHERE) to filter on aggregate results: HAVING AVG(r.rating) >= 4.0 AND COUNT(r.review_id) >= 3.
explanation: The JOIN combines product info with review data. HAVING applies two simultaneous aggregate filters. Laptop Pro: avg=4.25, count=4 ✓. Bluetooth Speaker: avg=4.33, count=3 ✓. Yoga Mat: avg=4.67, count=3 ✓. Running Shoes: avg=3.0 ✗ (avg too low). Coffee Maker: count=2 ✗ (too few reviews). Headphones: count=2 ✗. Three products qualify.
